title: Wegovy linked to rare “eye stroke” that can cause sudden blindness
summary: A new analysis is raising concerns about Wegovy, the blockbuster weight-loss drug, after researchers found it may carry the highest risk of a rare “eye stroke” that can cause sudden vision loss.
